"""Compute the count, mean, and median of the numbers in data.txt."""

from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean, median

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

numbers = []
for line in (HERE / "data.txt").read_text().splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if line:
        numbers.append(int(line) if line.lstrip("+-").isdigit() else float(line))

with open(HERE / "stats.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(f"count: {len(numbers)}\n")
    f.write(f"mean: {mean(numbers)}\n")
    f.write(f"median: {median(numbers)}\n")
